description: Credit-weighted semester GPA, cumulative GPA (with previous credits and GPA) and the average you need over the remaining credits to reach a target. Scales: 4.0 (A…F, no A+), 4.3 (A+ = 4.3), 5.0 (A+ 5, A 4.75, B+ 4.5 … F 1) with letter grades, or "percent" with numeric marks between a minimum and maximum (default 35–100). Courses with no credits or an invalid grade are skipped (and listed). Up to 40 courses. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/gpa-calc/

grade.description: Letter grade (A, B+, …) on letter scales, or the mark on the percent scale.

remainingCredits.description: Credits still to take after this semester (for the target).

name: calc_gpa
title: GPA calculator
